fieldDescription: Enable observation and the selected coordination mode.
Observe records proposals without issuing orders. Coordinate enables experimental regrouping orders for eligible ships. Both modes retain the normal ship pilot.
Include your autonomous ships. Your manually piloted ship and allied fleets retain their own control.
Include eligible enemy ships. Existing enemy commander orders are preserved.
Include refit simulations and the fleet trial.
Show the current mode and proposal counts in the combat status area.
Show a short action above ships that Omega is directing. Hide the label when Omega has no active order.
Record changed proposals and periodic diagnostics in starsector.log. Useful when comparing Observe and Coordinate.
